harness_observation: Initial harness waited for launcher text "shutdown complete; runtime retired" and asserted after 240 seconds. SIGTERM completed Uvicorn/Scheduler cleanup and process exit instead (Uvicorn re-raises captured SIGTERM, also observed OFF exit -15). The log-string predicate was incorrect, not a runtime failure. Actual protected cancellation, re-entry and graceful-retirement predicates above are verified from the retained original log; no runtime change or forced kill.
